meta.title: Savings Calculation: Attempt to save with special characters in custom reference

steps.note: Create the eRFX draft required by the scenario.
Apply a pricing template so savings configuration is available.
Add a line item required for the savings calculation flow.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Create the saved, unpublished eRFX draft.
Navigate to the events list to access drafts.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the scenario.
Verify that the draft created by this plan appears in Drafts.
Confirm the Savings Calculation window opened.

args.goal: In the Savings Calculation window, click Add Custom Reference, enter !@#$%^&*()_+{}|:<>? in the reference field, click Save, and record the resulting message or saved-row state on screen.

steps.note: Perform and observe the custom-reference save operation, including its response to the special characters.
Verify the resulting screen has no crash, server error, or malformed content.
